tone.title: Zuta GBG120 (EL34, 6L6) "MultiLoad" community pack — Amp Head
tone.description:
🅰️2️⃣ ready!
😮 Parametric (AMP & POW) models (Genome) in the full Ko-Fi pack

Get the ✨full✨ Zuta GBG120 (EL34, 6L6) "MultiLoad" pack here:

👉 https://ko-fi.com/2dornam/shop 🙏

Ladies, gents - the Zuta GBG120 (EL34, 6L6) an engineering marvel.

As a part of the scene that became legendary in the Late 80's through the 90's known to the world as “The Gothenburg Sound”, ZUTA has introduced the revolutionary & ultimate guitar amplifier for the most discerning musicians.

ℹ️ “MultiLoad” - what’s this about?

The cabinet (or load) a tube amplifier interacts with has a considerable impact on the tone & feel.
For this pack, I used 2 iconic cabinets and reamped all AMP and POW settings with each cab.

ℹ️ Summary

The pack features a Zuta GBG120 (EL34, 6L6 loaded) amp captured using 2 iconic cabinets loading down the amplifier.

✅ All profiles calibrated
✅ 2 iconic guitar cabs used as loads (no reactive load):
🟣 Mesa 4x12 OS Straight
🟣 Marshall 4x12 1960BV with Marshall G12 Vintage speakers
✅ AMP, PRE & POW profiles for maximum flexibility
✅ DI and MIC-ed up flavors for each AMP and POW profile
✅ NAM A2 ready
✅ Extended, anti-aliasing signal leveraged during reamping
✅ High-fidelity signal chain used during reamping
✅ Stompbox / OD profiles included

The full pack includes includes:

• 120 x AMP settings (1 x DI and 5 mic-ed up, full-rig profiles for every knob combination used)
• 72 x POW settings (1 x DI and 5 mic-ed up, full-rig profiles for every knob combination used)
• 53 x PRE settings
• 50 x OD pedal settings
• 4 x parametric "One-Trick Pony" models with the Mesa 4x12 OS Straight cabinet (1 for each amp channel); Gain and Presence knobs modeled
• 4 x parametric "One-Trick Pony" models with the Marshall 4x12 1960BV cabinet (1 for each amp channel); Gain and Presence knobs modeled
• 12 x parametric POW (poweramp) models in all power tube modes across both cabinets


TOTAL: over 1,200 individual NAM files + 20 parametric models

✅ Efficiency

Streamlined for users across platforms AMP & POW profiles offer 6 flavors:

• DI = raw poweramp <-> cab signal tapped with a DI box, no Microphone
• SM57 = full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with a Shure SM57 on the top-left speaker
• SM58 = full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with a Shure SM58 on the top-right speaker
• BLEND #1: full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with 2 mics (Shure SM57 & SM58) blended
• BLEND #2: full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with 2 mics (Shure SM57 & SM58 @ +4dB) blended
• BLEND #3: full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with 2 mics (Shure SM57 @ +4dB & SM58) blended

⚙️ Reamp chain details

• RME Fireface UCX II -> Lehle P-SPLIT III -> Zuta GBG120 -> St.Rock React:IR II (Mesa 4x12 OS Straight / Marshall 4x12 1960BV) -> RME Fireface UCX II

• SEND level: 18.995 dBu

Use the "Calibration" feature (video linked) in the NAM plugin to get the most out of these profiles:

www.neuralampmodeler.com/post/neuralampmodelerplugin-v0-7-12-is-released

🏷️ Naming convention summary

• [AMP] = full head (pre & poweramp)
• [PRE] = preamp only (no poweramp)
• [POW] = poweramp only (no preamp)
• [OD] = overdrive pedal
• Mar412 = Marshall 4x12 1960BV cabinet used as load
• Mes412 = Mesa 4x12 Oversized Straight cabinet used as load
• CH1 / CH2 / CH3 / CH4 = channel identifiers
• AB = AB power mode (EL34 and 6L6 tubes used)
• A = A power mode (6L6 tubes used)
• B = B power mode (EL34 tubes used)
• STD (A2) = new go-to NAM A2 standard architecture
• TSMINI = Tube Screamer Mini
• MXRM77 = MXR Custom Badass Modified O.D.
• FORTIN14 = Fortin Fourteen
• DWHAMER = PedalPCB Dwarven Hammer
• DFXKoD = DemonFX King of Drive
• DFXKLON = DemonFX Centaur
• DFXDBOOST = DemonFX Dual Boost, Exotic EP mode
• JR.TheJef = J.Rockett Audio Designs The Jeff Archer
• GRIND = Fortin Grind
• ODD = Warm Audio ODD
• BO$$ = Boss GE-7 Equalizer
